item.title: Sky Chord
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: MELLOW
  • 発売日: 2024-05-31
  • スコア: 6.890000000000001/10 (63 人評価)
  • 日本語名: スカイコード
  • 英語名: Sky Chord

あらすじ

“Suicidal ideation”――.

“I wish my existence would disappear from this world.”

A young boy living in the city, Yomiya Hashigo, while lying on his school’s flower bed, and looking up at the blue sky, wishes. The sound of the cicadas piercing his ears, the hot sunlight scorching his body, with the hustle and bustle of the students in the distant. But he is only drawn to the blue, azure sky――to him, a peaceful moment.

item.title: 2045, Tsuki yori.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: MELLOW
  • 発売日: 2022-09-30
  • スコア: 7.33/10 (58 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ２０４５、月より。
  • 英語名: 2045, Tsuki yori.

别名

  • The Butterfly Dream

あらすじ

——She had a dream. She dreamed of becoming a butterfly.

She freely crossed the glittering stars, and was eventually drawn to the “blue”.

Her body was heavy, the sky blue, and everything she touched seemed to shine for the first time.

Butterflies move their wings with all their might and head somewhere.

item.title: Asagao wa Ai o Shiranai.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: MELLOW
  • 発売日: 2021-07-30
  • スコア: 7.07/10 (53 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アサガオは夜を識らない。
  • 英語名: Asagao wa Ai o Shiranai.

别名

  • Asaai

あらすじ

The sound of seagulls woke me up.

Sunlight streamed through the train window, and outside, the train raced across the sea, kicking up spray from the swollen waters after yesterday’s rain.

The summer sunlight was blindingly white, and the wake trailing the train was just as bright.

The sky was a gradient of blue, indigo, and turquoise.

item.description:

あらすじ

“You know, I really like the smell of rain. I heard it’s called petrichor.”

The smell of rain reminds him of that day—a certain night 2 years ago.

“I want to have sex with you. Take my virginity.”

Takumi, the protagonist, met Akari, Erika’s friend, who he hadn’t seen in awhile. She begged to have sex with him and he gave in.
